UI_optionscreen_binding_LSW Find Item: Find an item you have seen
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_Description: Search for items by name among the places your character has seen them. Open the search window with the magnifier button on the left sidebar, under Inventory, or a key you set in Key Bindings, under Last Seen Where. These settings are yours alone; a server can make everyone use one search rule.
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_SearchRule_tooltip: What the search window looks through. What I have seen: only containers and floors your character has looked at. Shared: also what the members of your faction and safehouse have seen (multiplayer). Opened by anyone: also every container anyone has opened and anything anyone has seen. You can also change this in the search window. If the server picks a rule for everyone, this setting is ignored.
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_SearchRule_Shared: Shared with my faction and safehouse
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_NameFormat_tooltip: How the search window names who found something: the server's setting, the username, or the character name. You can also change this at the bottom of the search window. Only names the server lets you see are shown (faction and safehouse members, or everyone when the server's Faction option is off).
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_ArrowColour_tooltip: Colour and opacity of the arrow on the floor and the small arrows in the search window. The highlight on the place you look for uses the same colour.
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_ArrowSize_tooltip: Length and width of the arrow on the floor. 100 is a tile long.
